caseName: United States ex rel. Lee Kum Hoy v. Shaughnessy
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Lee Kum Hoy v. Shaughnessy, District Director, Immigration and Naturalization Service

opinions.text: Certiorari, 352 U. S. 966, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. The motion to substitute John L. Murff as the party respondent in the place and stead of Edward J. Shaughnessy, retired, is granted.
